017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.net.*;
022import java.time.*;
023import java.util.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.commons.http.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.http.header.*;
027
028/**
029 * A fluent accessor for a named HTTP response header.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * Provides convenient typed-access methods for reading header values.
033 * Returns {@code null} or empty results when the named header is absent from the response.
034 *
035 * <p>
036 * Obtain instances via {@link RestResponse#header(String)}.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack.
040 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
041 * (and possibly earlier).
042 *
043 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
044 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
045 * </ul>
046 *
047 * @since 9.2.1
048 */
049@SuppressWarnings({
050   "resource" // Eclipse resource analysis: response is borrowed; caller closes it
051})
052public final class ResponseHeader {
053
054   private final String name;
055
056   private final RestResponse response;
057
058   ResponseHeader(String name, RestResponse response) {
059      this.name = name;
060      this.response = response;
061   }
062
063   /**
064    * Returns the header name.
065    *
066    * @return The header name. Never <jk>null</jk>.
067    */
068   public String getName() {
069      return name;
070   }
071
072   /**
073    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if this header is present in the response.
074    *
075    * @return <jk>true</jk> if present.
076    */
077   public boolean isPresent() {
078      return response.getFirstHeader(name) != null;
079   }
080
081   /**
082    * Returns the first value of this header, or <jk>null</jk> if absent.
083    *
084    * @return The header value, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
085    */
086   public String getValue() {
087      var h = response.getFirstHeader(name);
088      return h != null ? h.value() : null;
089   }
090
091   /**
092    * Returns the first value of this header, or the given default if absent.
093    *
094    * @param defaultValue The default value to return when the header is absent.
095    * @return The header value, or {@code defaultValue} if absent.
096    */
097   public String orElse(String defaultValue) {
098      var value = getValue();
099      return or(value, defaultValue);
100   }
101
102   /**
103    * Returns the first value of this header as an {@link Optional}.
104    *
105    * @return An optional containing the first header value, or empty if absent.
106    */
107   public Optional<String> asOptional() {
108      return o(getValue());
109   }
110
111   /**
112    * Returns the first value of this header parsed as an {@code int}, or {@code -1} if absent or not parseable.
113    *
114    * @return The integer value, or {@code -1} if absent or not an integer.
115    */
116   public int asInteger() {
117      var value = getValue();
118      if (value == null)
119         return -1;
120      try {
121         return Integer.parseInt(value.trim());
122      } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
123         return -1;
124      }
125   }
126
127   /**
128    * Returns the first value of this header parsed as a {@code long}, or {@code -1L} if absent or not parseable.
129    *
130    * @return The long value, or {@code -1L} if absent or not a long.
131    */
132   public long asLong() {
133      var value = getValue();
134      if (value == null)
135         return -1L;
136      try {
137         return Long.parseLong(value.trim());
138      } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
139         return -1L;
140      }
141   }
142
143   /**
144    * Returns all values of this header.
145    *
146    * <p>
147    * For repeated headers, this returns each header value in encounter order.
148    *
149    * @return An unmodifiable list of header values. Never <jk>null</jk>, but possibly empty.
150    */
151   public List<String> getValues() {
152      return response.getHeaders().stream()
153         .filter(h -> eqic(name, h.name()))
154         .map(TransportHeader::value)
155         .toList();
156   }
157
158   /**
159    * Returns the first value as a comma-split list of individual tokens.
160    *
161    * <p>
162    * Useful for headers like {@code Accept} or {@code Allow} that combine multiple values with commas.
163    *
164    * @return A list of trimmed tokens. Never <jk>null</jk>, but possibly empty.
165    */
166   public List<String> asCsvList() {
167      var value = getValue();
168      if (value == null)
169         return List.of();
170      return Arrays.stream(value.split(","))
171         .map(String::trim)
172         .filter(s -> !s.isEmpty())
173         .toList();
174   }
175
176   /**
177    * Returns the first value of this header parsed as a {@link Boolean}.
178    *
179    * @return The boolean value, or empty if absent.
180    */
181   public Optional<Boolean> asBoolean() {
182      var value = getValue();
183      return value == null ? oe() : o(Boolean.parseBoolean(value.trim()));
184   }
185
186   /**
187    * Returns the first value of this header parsed as an RFC-1123 HTTP date.
188    *
189    * @return The parsed date, or empty if absent or not parseable.
190    */
191   public Optional<ZonedDateTime> asZonedDateTime() {
192      var value = getValue();
193      if (value == null)
194         return oe();
195      try {
196         return HttpDateHeader.of(name, value).asZonedDateTime();
197      } catch (DateTimeException e) {
198         return oe();
199      }
200   }
201
202   /**
203    * Returns the first value of this header parsed as a {@link URI}.
204    *
205    * @return The parsed URI, or empty if absent or not a valid URI.
206    */
207   public Optional<URI> asUri() {
208      var value = getValue();
209      if (value == null)
210         return oe();
211      try {
212         return o(new URI(value));
213      } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
214         return oe();
215      }
216   }
217
218   /**
219    * Returns the first value of this header parsed as a single {@link EntityTag} validator (e.g. {@code ETag}).
220    *
221    * @return The parsed entity tag, or empty if absent.
222    */
223   public Optional<EntityTag> asEntityTag() {
224      try {
225         return o(EntityTag.of(getValue()));
226      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
227         return oe();
228      }
229   }
230
231   /**
232    * Returns the first value of this header parsed as a comma-delimited list of {@link EntityTag} validators
233    * (e.g. {@code If-Match}).
234    *
235    * @return The parsed entity tags, or {@link EntityTags#EMPTY} if absent or not parseable. Never <jk>null</jk>.
236    */
237   public EntityTags asEntityTags() {
238      try {
239         return EntityTags.of(getValue());
240      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
241         return EntityTags.EMPTY;
242      }
243   }
244
245   /**
246    * Returns the first value of this header parsed as a q-valued list of string ranges (e.g. {@code Accept-Encoding}).
247    *
248    * @return The parsed string ranges. Never <jk>null</jk>, but possibly empty.
249    */
250   public StringRanges asStringRanges() {
251      return StringRanges.of(getValue());
252   }
253
254   @Override /* Object */
255   public String toString() {
256      var value = getValue();
257      return value != null ? name + ": " + value : name + ": <absent>";
258   }
259}
